crossRefs.note: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn…
Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways; and they will say in all…
Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and…
He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of…
I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell…
so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the…
I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble…

translations.web: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky, yes, the fish of the sea also die.
translations.bsb: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air; even the fish of the sea disappear.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
translations.asv: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
